headline: Executive Contact Centre Team Leader | Customer Service Operations | 18 Years Experience | Pretoria, South Africa
summary: Results-driven operations leader with 18 years of progressive experience transitioning from logistics to customer service. Proven track record in scaling contact centres, improving CSAT, reducing costs, and driving compliance. Based in Pretoria with deep understanding of South African operational and regulatory environments.
